name: HaiTun WaveRider 3x3 V2 Standard (Magnetic, 20-Magnet Ball-Core)
description: The HaiTun WaveRider 3x3 V2 Standard is the entry point into the WaveRider V2 family — a magnetic speed cube built on a 20-magnet ball-core with an extra 6 magnetic rings for a total of 88 magnets. It pairs a fully numerical tuning system with a soft-gloss finish and a light 71g build, so you get a genuinely tunable flagship experience without stepping up a tier.
features: Tune it to a top cuber's setup: The fully numerical system lets a beginner dial in an exact feel and repeat it, so you're not guessing.
Comfortable for long sessions: At 56mm and 71g, it stays controllable through long practice without wearing out your hand.
64 tactile combinations: 8 levels of spring compression multiplied by 8 levels of center tension give you 64 distinct feels to choose from.
Numbered dials, not guesswork: Precision micro-numerical settings mean you can note your favorite setup and return to it exactly.
26-point core positioning: Up to 26 magnets in the core drive 3D accelerated magnetic positioning for a high-density magnetic field inside the cube.
Great corner-cutting: Rounded, gradient-curved surfaces with big corner-cutting and anti corner-twist help it move through catch points instead of locking up.
